data.title: 五河琴里 · 暖桌旁水手服白发带的稚气熟睡
data.description: 初春微凉的午后五河家客厅，琴里戴着纯白软妹发带，穿着来禅中学水手服钻在暖桌里，怀里抱着巨型玩偶甜甜入睡，嘴角带着晶莹微笑。
data.action: 下半身钻入日式暖桌，上半身趴在桌面软垫上，怀抱毛绒小熊闭目熟睡，白发带轻软垂落
data.lighting: 阳光穿透阳台白纱，在客厅地板与暖桌被子上织出柔和光晕
data.camera: 俯拍特写，捕捉纯真妹妹模式毫无心防的恬静面容
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, itsuka kotori, red hair, long twintails, white ribbons imouto mode, red eyes closed sleeping peacefully, raizen junior high school uniform, navy sailor collar, hugging giant plush bear doll, half inside warm wooden kotatsu table on tatami floor, gentle afternoon sunlight through lace curtains, angelic innocent expression, adorable sister charm.
data.animaCaption: 1girl, solo, itsuka kotori, red twintails with white ribbons, sailor uniform sleeping peacefully in kotatsu.
